studio.title: A label built on craft & care
paragraphs: Founded by Archana Soni in Ahmedabad, Aarchi's crafts timeless designs that celebrate elegance and individuality — from bridal lehengas with zari, zardozi and khat work to handcrafted sarees and festive wear.
Every piece is made to measure and designed around you, blending traditional craftsmanship with a contemporary sensibility.

items.q: Do you make custom, made-to-measure outfits?
items.a: Yes — every piece at Aarchi's is made to measure. Bridal lehengas, sarees, festive and Navratri wear, baby-shower and maternity outfits are designed around your measurements, and the colour, fabric and embroidery of any catalogue design can be customised.

items.q: Do you ship outside India — USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE?
items.a: Yes, we ship worldwide. Many of our clients are NRI brides and families ordering custom Indian wedding and festive outfits from abroad. Share your requirement on WhatsApp (+91 98793 90731) and we'll guide you through measurements, fittings and delivery.

items.q: How do I order a custom bridal lehenga or saree?
items.a: Browse the catalogue, pick a design you love or bring your own reference, and enquire on WhatsApp. Archana will discuss the design, fabric and budget with you, guide your measurements, and craft the piece in her Ahmedabad studio.

items.q: Can I change the colour or fabric of a catalogue design?
items.a: Absolutely. Every design is a starting point — colours, fabrics, embroidery and silhouettes are tailored to you. Tell us what you'd like to change when you enquire.
The studio is in Ahmedabad, Gujarat — visits by appointment. Outstation and international clients are looked after end-to-end on WhatsApp.

localSeo.title: Bridal wear designer in Ahmedabad
paragraphs: If you're searching for a custom lehenga in Ahmedabad, this is where it's made. At Aarchi's, Archana Soni designs and tailors every piece to your measurements — bridal lehengas worked in zari, zardozi and khat, handcrafted sarees, and occasion wear that fits the way ready-made never quite does.

Come festival season, the studio turns to garba nights — as a Navratri chaniya choli designer, Archana crafts festive ensembles you can twirl in. And for the quieter celebrations, she's the baby shower outfit designer in Ahmedabad mums-to-be come back to. Studio visits by appointment; start the conversation on WhatsApp.

about.title: Meet Archana Soni
paragraphs: Fashion has always been my passion, and I take pride in crafting timeless designs that celebrate elegance and individuality. Based in Ahmedabad, I specialise in creating outfits that make every occasion truly extraordinary.

From custom creations to signature styles — bridal lehengas with zari, zardozi and khat work, handcrafted sarees, festive and maternity wear — my goal is to bring your dream outfits to life. Let's redefine elegance together.

howItWorks.lead: Every Aarchi's piece is made to measure — here's exactly how a custom outfit comes to life, whether you're in Ahmedabad or across the world.

steps.title: Consultation on WhatsApp
steps.text: Tell us the occasion, your ideas and budget — share reference photos or pick a catalogue design as the starting point.

steps.title: Design & fabric

faq.q: Do I need to visit the studio?
faq.a: No — the whole process runs on WhatsApp if you prefer: consultation, video-guided measurements, progress photos and a fitting review before shipping. Studio visits in Ahmedabad are welcome by appointment.

faq.q: How are measurements taken remotely?
faq.a: On a short WhatsApp video call, Archana guides you through each measurement step by step. You need a measuring tape and ideally someone to help.

faq.q: Can I customise a catalogue design?
faq.a: Yes — every catalogue piece is a starting point. Colours, fabrics, embroidery and silhouettes are tailored to you.

faq.q: How is the price decided?
faq.a: Each piece is quoted individually based on fabric, hand-work and construction. Share your budget in the first chat and the design is worked around it.

howItWorks.metaDescription: From a WhatsApp consultation to your door: how Aarchi's designs, measures, crafts and delivers made-to-measure Indian outfits from the Ahmedabad studio — locally and worldwide.

faq.q: Can I order a custom bridal lehenga from India to the USA or UK?
faq.a: Yes — that's exactly what we do. The consultation, design and measurements all happen on WhatsApp, the outfit is handcrafted in Ahmedabad, and it ships to your door in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE and beyond.

faq.q: How do made-to-measure outfits work online?
faq.a: Measurements are taken on a video-guided WhatsApp call, and you review the finished outfit on photos and video before it ships — so nothing is left to chance.

faq.q: What if it doesn't fit when it arrives?
faq.a: Made-to-measure cuts fit risk dramatically, and every piece is checked against your measurements before shipping. If something needs adjusting, message us and we'll guide the alteration with a local tailor.

faq.q: Do you understand what NRI brides need?
faq.a: Many of our clients order from abroad for weddings in India or celebrations overseas. Timezone-friendly chats, clear progress photos and honest timelines are part of the service.

navratri.title: Navratri, made to twirl
navratri.lead: Custom chaniya cholis and festive ensembles for garba nights — designed and made to measure in Ahmedabad by Archana Soni. Nine nights deserve better than off-the-rack.

faq.q: Do you design custom chaniya cholis for Navratri?
faq.a: Yes — Navratri and garba-night ensembles are made to order at the Ahmedabad studio. Pick a design from the festive edit or bring a reference, and it's cut to your measurements with the colours and work you choose.

faq.q: How early should I order before Navratri?
faq.a: The earlier the better — festive season slots fill fast. Message us on WhatsApp with your date and we'll confirm what's possible for your timeline.

faq.q: Can I customise the colours or mirror work?
faq.a: Absolutely. Colours, fabrics, embroidery and mirror work are all tailored to you — every piece is a starting point.

faq.q: I'm not in Ahmedabad — can you still make my Navratri outfit?
faq.a: Yes. Measurements are guided over WhatsApp video and finished outfits ship across India and worldwide.
